  • Constructor Details

    • Industry

      public Industry(String mapName, IndustryType type, int positionX, int positionY)
      Constructs an Industry instance with the specified map name, industry type, and location coordinates.
      Parameters:
      mapName - the name of the map where the industry is located
      type - the type of the industry (e.g., IRON_MINE, COAL_MINE)
      positionX - the x-coordinate of the industry's location
      positionY - the y-coordinate of the industry's location
